functions.name: Question and falsifier specification
functions.purpose: Turn a proposed research claim into a bounded question, estimand, comparator, decision consequence, and observable contradiction condition before outcomes are accessed.
required_methods: Separate scientific, safety, standards, and product questions.
Specify the target population, unit, exposure, comparator, outcome, horizon, and falsifier.
quality_controls: Reject claims that cannot be contradicted by an eligible observation.
Keep every proposed claim distinct from an accepted finding.

may_advance_when: The question has an explicit estimand, comparator, falsifier, and decision use.
The question stays within the accepted mission and current gate.
must_stop_when: The question implies runtime, private data, vehicle control, or an unsupported authority.
The comparator or falsifier is absent or changes after outcome access.

functions.name: Source custody and authority classification
functions.purpose: Resolve source identity, exact version, custody, redistribution, evidence eligibility, scope, and authority limits before a source can support any mapping.
required_methods: Retain exact permitted bytes or create a pointer-only record.
Record publication date, retrieval provenance, digest, access terms, redistribution basis, scope, and limitations.
quality_controls: Fail closed when redistribution or source identity is unmeasured.
Never promote a company statement, patent, job posting, signature, or consensus to independent evidence.

may_advance_when: Every retained payload is inventory-bound and eligible for its declared use.
Every pointer-only source is structurally ineligible as evidence.
must_stop_when: A payload lacks observed redistribution authority.
A source version, date, scope, comparator, or authority boundary is unresolved.

functions.name: Construct and measurement validation
functions.purpose: Define the latent construct, actor, object, horizon, reference process, measurement model, validity evidence, and proxy limits before measurement.
required_methods: Use multiple methods when no single measurement can identify the construct.
Separate convergent validity, discriminant validity, reliability, calibration, and applicability.
quality_controls: Prohibit attention, gaze, drowsiness, workload, reaction time, or confidence from silently substituting for belief, readiness, or recovery.
Preserve discordant methods and non-observed states.

may_advance_when: The construct has a typed holder, target, horizon, reference, and validity boundary.
Every proxy has an explicit measurement argument and falsifier.
must_stop_when: A proxy is treated as ground truth without validation.
The reference process shares an undisclosed dependency with the evaluated method.

functions.name: Study design and immutable preregistration
functions.purpose: Freeze the identification design, power or precision plan, stopping rules, causal structure, controls, missingness, splits, access chronology, deviations, and analysis boundary.
required_methods: Choose a design family before outcome access.
Specify causal graph, negative controls, placebo outcomes, missingness sensitivity, sampling, stopping, interim analysis, and deviation handling.
quality_controls: Bind every freeze and data-access event to exact time and artifact identity.
Label amendments and exploratory analyses without inheriting preregistration.

may_advance_when: The design is internally coherent and frozen before prohibited outcome access.
Power, precision, stopping, missingness, and split rules are explicit.
must_stop_when: Outcome information was accessed before the relevant freeze.
Identification assumptions, controls, or missingness sensitivity are absent.

functions.name: Dataset and benchmark governance
functions.purpose: Specify participant, consent, ethics, sensor, synchronization, annotation, adjudication, split, leakage, contamination, maintenance, correction, and deprecation contracts without ingesting data.
required_methods: Version subjects, encounters, vehicles, routes, scenarios, labels, and access events.
Split at the highest dependence and leakage unit required by the estimand.
quality_controls: Record contamination searches and limitations.
Keep missing sensor data, withdrawn consent, and invalid synchronization distinct.

may_advance_when: A static dataset release and benchmark risk record are complete.
No private or operational payload enters Gate A.
must_stop_when: Consent, redistribution, ethics, provenance, split chronology, or contamination status is unresolved.
A benchmark owner can silently change labels, tests, or access.

functions.name: ODD, scenario, and test case design
functions.purpose: Bind the operational domain, current conditions, scenario family, test case, oracle, expected result, coverage target, and change impact before evaluation.
required_methods: Use versioned include and exclude conditions.
Separate real seed, synthetic mutation, oracle uncertainty, simulation fidelity, and prospective road validation.
quality_controls: Report untested and unsupported ODD cells.
Do not infer real-world validity from scenario count or simulated hours.

may_advance_when: Every test case has identity, objective, inputs, steps, platform, oracle, expected result, and coverage relation.
ODD exits and unknown current conditions are explicit.
must_stop_when: The ODD cannot be evaluated from available conditions.
The oracle, simulation fidelity, or test selection mechanism is unqualified.

functions.name: Observation and temporal information set
functions.purpose: Record what was measured, when it occurred, when it became available, who could access it, and whether it belonged to the belief or decision information set.
required_methods: Separate event, measurement, availability, and record times.
Bind source, actor membership, disclosure, withholding, validity, and provenance.
quality_controls: Reject future or unavailable inputs.
Preserve missing, unmeasured, out-of-distribution, sensor-invalid, and abstained states.

may_advance_when: Every belief and decision input was available to the named actor by the relevant time.
Information-set membership and disclosure are reconciled.
must_stop_when: Availability time is missing or later than belief or decision time.
An input source, actor, disclosure state, or validity boundary is unresolved.

functions.name: Object-level human and automation belief assessment
functions.purpose: Evaluate separately what each named actor believed about the same object or relation under the actor's actual information set and declared applicability domain.
required_methods: Bind holder, target agent or object, state space, horizon, calibration target, elicitation or inference method, reference process, and decision loss.
Evaluate normalization, proper scoring, calibration, coverage, and abstention.
quality_controls: Never infer human comprehension from gaze alone.
Never treat an automation confidence score as a calibrated belief outside its declared target and domain.

may_advance_when: Human and automation beliefs are independently identifiable and comparable on a common opportunity.
Calibration and applicability dispositions are explicit.
must_stop_when: Belief holder, target, information set, reference, or calibration target is absent.
The belief distribution is invalid or coerces a non-observed state.

functions.name: Joint performance, readiness, and recoverability
functions.purpose: Evaluate human-only, automation-only, team, fallback, and oracle opportunities while resolving readiness phases, recovery events, joint silent misses, and dependence.
required_methods: Use a common object-time opportunity and equal-information accounting.
Separate perception, comprehension, projection, decision, motor initiation, stabilization, censoring, and competing events.
quality_controls: Report every channel marginal and joint event.
Model dependence and prohibit multiplication of reliabilities without justified independence.

may_advance_when: All channel opportunities, validity states, disclosures, effort, fallback, windows, and outcomes reconcile.
Team value is compared with the best eligible standalone actor and complementarity potential.
must_stop_when: A relevant channel or fallback is unobserved but encoded as no miss.
A readiness proxy improves while hazard recognition or recovery contradicts it without explicit disposition.

functions.name: Causal and sequential policy evaluation
functions.purpose: Estimate only identified policy contrasts with exact behavior and target policies, trajectories, propensities, support, rewards, safety costs, estimators, and missingness assumptions.
required_methods: Separate assignment, delivery, receipt, adherence, contamination, and intervention.
Report positivity, effective sample size, weight tails, truncation, estimator registry, selection boundary, disagreement, missingness, and safety constraints.
quality_controls: Keep observational association distinct from causal effect.
Invalidate unsupported policies or estimators instead of extrapolating.

may_advance_when: The target policy is supported by logged behavior under the frozen design.
Estimator selection and uncertainty use only authorized data.
must_stop_when: Support, propensity provenance, effective sample size, missingness identification, or safety constraints fail.
Estimator disagreement exceeds the preregistered decision rule.

functions.name: Selective prediction, OOD, and conformal assurance
functions.purpose: Evaluate accepted and rejected cases under explicit novelty, ambiguity, sensor validity, calibration, exchangeability, shift, and group-conditional coverage contracts.
required_methods: Separate novelty rejection, ambiguity rejection, sensor invalidity, missingness, unmeasured state, and protocol abstention.
Report accepted and rejected denominators, risk-coverage, error-reject, marginal and group-conditional coverage.
quality_controls: Bind calibration release and exchangeability or shift assumptions.
Invalidate guarantees when their conditions fail.

may_advance_when: Coverage and risk are reported for every declared acceptance threshold and group.
Guarantee validity has an explicit supported, invalid, or inconclusive disposition under the architecture status vocabulary.
must_stop_when: Calibration identity or guarantee conditions are missing.
A rejected or invalid case enters the accepted denominator.

functions.name: Transfer and worst group validation
functions.purpose: Evaluate exact source and target domains, adaptation, target access, support, measurement invariance, complete group coverage, and simultaneous uncertainty.
required_methods: Freeze source and target releases, shift taxonomy, adaptation allowance, target tuning, group universe, intersections, membership measurement, multiplicity, and minimum information.
Report source, target, gap, support, calibration, every group, all worst ties, and low-information dispositions.
quality_controls: Never drop an unobserved or underpowered group.
Never infer target performance from source metadata or pooled calibration.

may_advance_when: Target support and measurement comparability meet the preregistered boundary.
Every declared group and intersection is present with effective sample size and simultaneous uncertainty.
must_stop_when: Support or measurement invariance fails.
A group is omitted, post hoc, mismeasured, or below minimum information without an explicit unknown disposition.

functions.name: Result, evidence, and lifecycle synthesis
functions.purpose: Bind results to the frozen study, protocol, source, metric, uncertainty, validity, and evidence objects while preserving every status and correction.
required_methods: Reconcile numerators, denominators, coverage, intervals, statuses, preregistration, and evidence witnesses.
Create append-only corrections, retractions, and replications with exact predecessor and independence lineage.
quality_controls: Do not let prose, hashes, validators, generated reviews, or consensus serve as scientific evidence.
Do not translate null, inconclusive, failed, contradicted, corrected, or retracted into supported.

may_advance_when: Every status matches its metric and evidence disposition.
All source, experiment, result, replication, correction, and retraction references resolve exactly.
must_stop_when: An evidence basis is ineligible, circular, stale, or missing.
A result status, denominator, uncertainty interval, preregistration, or lineage is incoherent.

functions.name: Independent review and gate decision
functions.purpose: Separate reproducibility, methodological review, safety review, standards review, legal review, and operator authority before any gate advancement.
required_methods: Name reviewer identity, competence, conflicts, reviewed bytes, method, findings, limitations, and disposition.
Replicate with a distinct experiment and declared independence before using replicated status.
quality_controls: Keep GA-17 external to offline validation.
Require a separately authorized contract for Gate B, runtime, publication, or deployment.

may_advance_when: All required independent reviews are complete and bind exact bytes.
An independently authorized operator makes a separate hash-bound decision.
must_stop_when: Reviewer independence or authority is unverified.
Any required evidence, replication, legal, standards, safety, or operator review is absent.

prohibited_shortcuts: Starting data collection, training, inference, simulation execution, deployment, or vehicle control from this registry.
Treating a discovery pointer as retained or evidence-eligible.
Collapsing observation, latent belief, decision, intervention, outcome, and evidence.
Using gaze, attention, drowsiness, workload, reaction time, or confidence as unvalidated ground truth for belief or readiness.
Treating missing, unmeasured, out-of-distribution, sensor-invalid, or abstained as zero or a confident label.
Selecting hypotheses, groups, estimators, thresholds, or outcome labels after prohibited outcome access without an explicit exploratory amendment.
Multiplying human and automation reliabilities without a justified dependence model.
Converting a company statement, patent, certificate summary, job posting, signature, checksum, validator pass, or consensus into independent scientific evidence.
Claiming causal effect without assignment, behavior policy, support, missingness, and identification evidence.
Omitting target domains, low-information groups, rejected cases, competing events, deviations, nulls, contradictions, corrections, or retractions.

Treating architecture completeness or static distribution authorization as Gate A acceptance, scientific support, safety validation, standards compliance, publication authority, or Gate B authorization.
Changing an immutable release identifier or accepted hash-bound byte in place.
